# Security policy

## Reporting a problem

Please **don't open a public issue** for security problems. Report them privately through
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/js-surya/bytecache/security/advisories/new)
for this repository. Include the ByteCache version, your device and OS, and steps to reproduce.

You'll get a reply within a week. Once a fix ships, you'll be credited in the release notes
unless you'd rather not be.

## Scope

- **In scope:** the ByteCache app, its share extensions and widgets, and how they store logins
  (Keychain), cache snippets and talk to a ByteStash server.
- **Out of scope:** the ByteStash server itself. Please report those to the
  [ByteStash project](https://github.com/jordan-dalby/ByteStash).

## Supported versions

Only the latest release gets security fixes.
